about.h1Title: Hello there! My name is Luigi, also known as Dævel.
about.introduction: I'm a Frontend Software Engineer. I build modern interfaces using React, Angular, and TypeScript, with a pragmatic approach to code scalability.
about.frontendArchitectureDescription: I like designing frontends that stay readable as the product grows: clear components, sharp responsibilities, and technical choices that are easy to explain.
about.userExperienceDescription: I do not stop at a UI that works: I look for rhythm, hierarchy, and small details that make an interface feel natural on every screen.
about.engineeringQualityDescription: I write code with the next person in mind: type safety, performance, and maintainability are not extras, they are part of the job.
about.approachTitle: How I build frontends that do more than just hold together

projects.introduction: A selection of project-driven work shaped by concrete goals: from the initial idea to technical decisions and the final experience.

followoo.description: Followoo is a privacy-first tool that allows you to analyze your Instagram relationships directly in the browser using the ZIP file provided by Instagram's official data export.

culturando.description: Culturando is a geolocated web app for sharing and discovering private book collections. It lets users publish books, search nearby volumes on a 3D map, request consultations or loans, and use AI features to catalog books from their covers while protecting privacy and location.
